entities.freshness_signal: tinybio-cloud/tiny repo active (not archived, 119 commits, no published releases); tinybio acquired by Seqera (Nextflow) in Aug 2024

entities.name: Cloudflare Agents SDK
entities.description: Verified from the repo: Cloudflare's open-source SDK for building and deploying stateful AI agents on Cloudflare Workers using Durable Objects, with persistent state sync, callable methods, scheduling, real-time communication, AI chat integration, and workflows.

entities.name: Hivemind
entities.description: Verified from the repo: 'Hivemind turns your traces into reusable skills across agents' — a cloud-backed, auto-learning shared-memory engine that captures agent session traces, codifies patterns into reusable skills, and propagates capability across a team's agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and more) in real time.
